text:
sam: FYI realtime cost card showed a weird 3x token spike at 11:14 UTC but reconciled numbers dropped it after ~90s. probable ingest ordering.

rina: saw it too. cache_hit stayed high while token_cost jumped. looks like event vs arrival time mismatch.

josh: quick repro: producer batches by tenant changed last week, might reorder events across partitions.

sam: short-term UX: show two labels on the Console card: "Realtime (est)" and "Reconciled (final ~2m)" + a small tooltip explaining delays.

leo: infra: plan is add sequence ids to producers and switch materialized view to event_time with a 60s watermark for reconciled panel.

rina: telemetry: emit reconciled_delta_pct and reconciled_latency_s when delta >5% so we can measure impact.

josh: I'll audit producer batching and add seq ids. sam, can you mock the UI copy and add a progress indicator?

ops-bot: muted realtime alerts for affected tenants (ticket IN-4590).

sam: action list: josh audit+seq, leo event_time MV + watermark, rina telemetry fields, UI dual-view + progress (sam). tracking IN-4590. :thumbsup:
